SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_vehicle v JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.vehicle_id=v.id WHERE pv.sku_id=#{skuId} AND v.status=2 AND NOT ) physical_qty, COALESCE(SUM(c.qty),0) committed_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_id=#{orderId} AND c.kind='ORDER' THEN c.qty ELSE 0 END),0) owned_qty FROM () c WHERE c.sku_id=#{skuId}

where.if: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_agent_model_access access JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=access.agent_id AND a.status='ENABLED' WHERE access.agent_id=#{agentId} AND access.model_id=s.model_id AND access.enabled=1 AND m.enabled=1)

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_production_sku s JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=s.model_id

WITH sc AS (), sku_commit AS (SELECT sku_id,model_id,SUM(qty) qty, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='TEMPORARY' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) temporary_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ORDER' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) order_qty FROM sc GROUP BY sku_id,model_id), sku_physical AS (SELECT pv.sku_id,COUNT(*) qty,SUM() quarantined FROM bike_vehicle v JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.vehicle_id=v.id WHERE v.status=2 GROUP BY pv.sku_id), model_physical AS (SELECT v.model_id,COUNT(*) qty FROM bike_vehicle v WHERE v.status=2 AND NOT GROUP BY v.model_id), model_commit AS (SELECT model_id,SUM(qty) qty FROM () c GROUP BY model_id), model_sku_commit AS (SELECT model_id,SUM(qty) qty FROM sc GROUP BY model_id) SELECT s.id sku_id,s.model_id,s.sku_code,s.product_name,s.specification,m.model_name, COALESCE(p.qty,0) physical_qty,COALESCE(p.quarantined,0) quarantined_qty, COALESCE(c.temporary_qty,0) temporary_locked_qty,COALESCE(c.order_qty,0) order_reserved_qty, GREATEST(0,COALESCE(p.qty,0)-COALESCE(p.quarantined,0)-COALESCE(c.qty,0)) available_qty, GREATEST(0,COALESCE(c.qty,0)-COALESCE(p.qty,0)+COALESCE(p.quarantined,0)) shortage_qty, COALESCE(mc.qty,0)-COALESCE(ms.qty,0) legacy_model_committed_qty, GREATEST(0,COALESCE(mp.qty,0)-COALESCE(mc.qty,0)) model_available_qty, GREATEST(0,LEAST(COALESCE(p.qty,0)-COALESCE(p.quarantined,0)-COALESCE(c.qty,0),COALESCE(mp.qty,0)-COALESCE(mc.qty,0))) max_new_lock_qty FROM bike_production_sku s JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=s.model_id LEFT JOIN sku_physical p ON p.sku_id=s.id LEFT JOIN sku_commit c ON c.sku_id=s.id LEFT JOIN model_physical mp ON mp.model_id=s.model_id LEFT JOIN model_commit mc ON mc.model_id=s.model_id LEFT JOIN model_sku_commit ms ON ms.model_id=s.model_id ORDER BY s.model_id,s.id LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT sku_id,ordered_qty,shipped_qty,closed_qty FROM bike_order_reservation_item WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY sku_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_order_reservation SET scope_type='SKU' WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_order_reservation_item(order_id,sku_id,ordered_qty) SELECT r.order_id,s.id,#{quantity} FROM bike_order_reservation r JOIN bike_production_sku s ON s.model_id=r.model_id WHERE r.order_id=#{orderId} AND s.id=#{skuId} AND r.scope_type='SKU'
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_order_reservation_item SET shipped_qty=shipped_qty+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND shipped_qty+closed_qty<ordered_qty
UPDATE bike_order_reservation_item SET shipped_qty=shipped_qty-1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND shipped_qty>0 AND closed_qty=0
UPDATE bike_order_reservation_item SET closed_qty=ordered_qty-shipped_qty WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
